body:
# **Sol's Party System** Sol's Party System is a lightweight yet powerful multiplayer party mod  that allows **players to team up, track each other, and coordinate seamlessly**. Whether you're exploring vast worlds, tackling dungeons, or just adventuring with friends, this mod keeps your party connected. **Note:** Required to be installed both **Server** and **Client.** *** **Need help, want to suggest a feature, or found a bug?** **Join our community to catch exclusive early previews and upcoming changelogs before they go live!** [![Join Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join_Server-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/PzYsNxanTA) *** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_2315ff35-11c0-4f7a-94cb-3e4f456f90d6.png)**

 

 

 

 

Features

### **Party Management** * **Create & Join Parties** - Easily create your own party or join existing ones * **Party Browser** - Browse available public parties with search functionality * **Invite System** - Invite friends to your party * **Party Capacity** - Configurable maximum party size ### **Party HUD** * **Real-time Member Tracking** - See your party members' health, hunger, and armor at a glance * **Self HUD** - Separate customizable display for your own stats * **Fully Configurable** - Adjust position, scale, and visibility of all HUD elements * **Clean Design** - Minimalist interface that doesn't clutter your screen ### **Ping System** * **Location Pings** - Ping any location up to 100 blocks away for your party to see * **Smart Markers** - Ping markers scale with distance for consistent visibility * **Detailed Labels** - See who pinged, exact coordinates, and distance when looking at pings * **Screen Edge Indicators** - Off-screen pings show directional arrows at screen edges * **Color-Coded** - Each party member has a unique color for their pings ### **Keybinds** * **P** - Open Party Menu * **V** - Ping Location * **H** - Toggle HUD *** ## **Configuration** All settings can be customized in the config file or through the mod menu: **Client Settings:** * HUD Position (X, Y) * HUD Scale * Self HUD Position & Scale * Enable/Disable Pings * Enable/Disable HUD **Server Settings:** * Maximum Party Size * Ping Duration * Party Visibility Options   *** ## **Installation** 1. Install **Minecraft Forge**  2. Download **Sol's Party System** 3. Place the .jar file in your `mods` **(client and server)** folder 4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy! *** ## **Bug Reports & Suggestions** Found a bug or have a suggestion? Don't hesitate to leave a comment! I will answer it as fast as I could :)   **Author**: solmochi
